automated.summary: All 24 required leaves executed and passed under the Node/JUnit discriminator - the testcase name must equal the leaf id verbatim AND must not be the FILE PATH, because tools/junit-run.mjs exits 0 and names the testcase after the file when --name matches nothing (D-0024), so an exit code proves nothing. Backend hermetic suite: 224 tests, 208 pass, 0 fail, 16 skipped (the pre-existing DB-gated warehouse leaves). verify.py passes. The seam is EXTRACTED rather than duplicated: MisDrillService's controller-oriented body now returns typed ok/replaced/gone/audit-failed outcomes with the row limit as an argument, and a leaf asserts the drill controller still maps every one of them to its shipped response - so the drill route's behaviour is unchanged while the assistant reuses the same sensitive query rather than writing a second one. Three things the task grill flagged as otherwise-cosmetic are proven for real. The row limit reaches the SQL: drill-transactions hard-coded LIMIT 100 with no limit argument, so a repository-level leaf now asserts 20 and 100 genuinely differ. D-0053's race is fixed in the REAL repository as one query, tested at repository level rather than through a fake that would have passed while the race shipped. And D-0052's digest leaf now returns a DIFFERENT outline than the attested one, so the mismatch branch is actually exercised - previously the comparison could have been skipped entirely and the leaf would still have passed. The focus contract is the optional typed object the grill required: an absent focus returns the server's focus-required variant instead of being rejected by the schema, and a crafted budget subject is refused before the read seam - both impossible under task 1's required nodeKey/block pair. Decision 0025 holds: a replaced but present batch is read and reported as its own outcome carrying the full leaf explanation plus a notice naming the source and period, while only a gone batch is refused. Decision 0027 holds and is asserted on the PROVIDER PAYLOAD, not the rendered answer: no server-sourced row, amount, batch id or measure value reaches the model, while the user's own question may carry a figure - which the motivating question requires.
